subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

Many children still do not have access to quality education that will **__harness__** their inherent abilities and talent.
solution:
The correct answer is **"misapply."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "harness"** means to utilize or make use of something, especially a resource or talent. (किसी चीज़ का उपयोग या उपयोग करना, विशेषकर किसी संसाधन या प्रतिभा का उपयोग करना)

 
 
• **Example**: S*he **harnesses**__ the computer's potential.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"harness"** is **"misapply."**
 
• **"Misapply"** means to use something in the wrong way or for the wrong purpose. (किसी चीज़ का गलत तरीके से या गलत उद्देश्य के लिए उपयोग करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She **misapplied**__ her artistic skills by using them to forge documents. *
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"direct," **means to guide or steer something in a particular direction. (किसी दिशा विशेष की ओर किसी बात का संकेत करना या लक्ष्‍य करना)
 
• Option 2, **"exploit,"** means to make use of something for personal gain, often in an unethical way. ((किसी का) शोषण करना)
 
• Option 3, **"handle," **means to manage or deal with something in a competent or effective way. (हाथ से छूना या सँभालना)
